title: Maintenance access not considered for equipment replacement
summary: A replaceable item could only be removed after removing several other items.
what_happened: During a maintainability review it was found that removing one line-replaceable item required disconnecting neighbouring pipes and equipment, increasing maintenance time and the risk of errors.
root_cause: Removal paths were not modelled or reviewed; maintainability was assessed after the installation layout had been fixed.
recommendation: Model removal and replacement paths for replaceable items as part of layout design, and include maintainers in early layout reviews.
applicability: Any replaceable equipment in congested bays; Preliminary and Detailed Design.
example_note: Generic, fictional example lesson (from v0.8, re-tagged to the v1.0 registers). Not authoritative engineering guidance.
